subject: Request for the park permit summary
text: As a community member preparing the clean-up, I am requesting a copy of the park permit summary for next month. The attachment would let me update the sign-in sheet and confirm which zones need extra gloves. When I tried to open the older version from the shared coworker drive, the browser froze after the first page, so I cannot see the safety notes. I do not think the file is corrupted, but the viewer may have timed out while loading it. If you can send a PDF directly, I can review it tonight and return any needed corrections before the planning session. Please include the current vendor list if it was added after the last email thread.
